scope: Independent source-only review of bounded ordinary-member Profile first-save, warm save/discard, reload, and original-absence restoration; no browser run or database mutation.

basis: The prior member evidence records a verified nonadmin identity and an absent owner profile row before any profile write.

The runner independently rechecks owner-row absence before the first UI save and binds cleanup DELETE to owner, device organization, unique marker, original creation timestamp, and exact observed version.
DELETE requires one returned owner row and a subsequent empty owner read. Cleanup exceptions make the overall report fail and mark restoration unverified.
No service-role credential or member token is written into the runner report; the owner token is read inside the extension panel.
limits: Live grants, RLS, version trigger, and current row absence were reported by the builder but were not independently queried in this source-only review; the native preflight and run must establish runtime truth.
If an unexpected write advances the version, the runner refuses deletion and may leave its owned row. This is a truthful, safe failure, not restoration proof.

findings: The new unit tests verify first-insert ownership and all conditional DELETE filters, including owner, organization, marker, timestamp, and version mismatches.

Those tests do not drive profile-native-acceptance.mjs through a failed first save, failed reload, or cleanup failure; they therefore cannot independently prove the report's no-false-pass behavior. The source branches appear fail-closed, but native execution remains required.

The initial row's version 1 and later versions 3 and 5 are contract assumptions. A differing live trigger behavior will fail before deletion and preserve the row; this must not be reported as a passing restoration.
B_quality.blocking_for_final_acceptance: No native run has yet verified member first save, warm and reload behavior, exact absence restoration, and report truthfulness.

data_handling: This review artifact contains no account identifiers, credentials, marker values, or raw row data.
